grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count=166158 and duplicate_row_rate=0.0, so every row is a distinct flight operation with no exact-duplicate rows to collapse; grain_type is transaction because one source row is one scheduled flight. No single column is unique on its own (flight_number tops out at 2994 distinct, tail_number at 3825, departure_hour_utc at 3439, all far under 166158), so the derived identifier flight_identity combines flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, and sched_dep_hhmm, which together pin down a scheduled flight instance even when flight numbers repeat across carriers, dates, or origins. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, this tuple already absorbs any potential duplication and no aggregation is required.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date the flight operated, ranging 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct dates with no nulls; a coarser calendar label than the hour-grain time column.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter operating-carrier code (16 distinct values such as AA, DL, UA) with no nulls, identifying the airline that operated the flight.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Numeric flight number ranging 1-8500 across 2994 distinct values with no nulls; it labels a specific flight rather than measuring anything.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Three-letter NYC-area origin airport code (EWR, JFK, or LGA) with no nulls, naming the departure airport.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure clock time encoded as HHMM, ranging 500-2359 across 969 distinct values with no nulls; a time-of-day label.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Three-letter destination airport code across 100 distinct values (e.g. ABQ, ACK, ALB) with no nulls.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft tail-number registration (3825 distinct values, e.g. N0EGMQ) with a 0.9154% null rate; nullable when the operating aircraft could not be matched to a registration.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Boolean flag with no nulls indicating whether the scheduled flight was cancelled.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time encoded as HHMM (1-2400) with a 2.9388% null rate; per the operator context a flight that never departed keeps no actual time, so it is null for those flights.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes, -33 to 1301 with negative meaning early, carrying the same 2.9388% null rate as dep_hhmm for flights that never departed; a measure compared and aggregated across flights.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time encoded as HHMM (1-2400) with a 3.07% null rate for flights lacking a recorded actual arrival.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival clock time encoded as HHMM, 1-2359 across 1134 distinct values, with no nulls.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes, -86 to 1272, with a 3.2981% null rate for flights without an actual arrival; a measure summed/averaged across flights.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Elapsed airborne time in minutes, 20-695, with a 3.2981% null rate matching arr_delay_minutes; a measure of flight duration.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance flown in miles, 80-4983, with no nulls; a measure aggregated across flights.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Scheduled departure hour in local time, 5-23 across 19 distinct values, with no nulls; a label component of the scheduled departure time.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Scheduled departure minute in local time, 0-59, with no nulls; a label component of the scheduled departure time.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: Scheduled departure instant in UTC, truncated to the hour as samples land exactly on :00:00 from 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 across 3439 distinct values, with no nulls; the event timestamp for this fact at hour grain.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full operating-carrier legal name (16 distinct values, e.g. Delta Air Lines Inc.) with no nulls, from the complete carrier lookup per the operator context.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer name (34 distinct values, e.g. BOEING, AIRBUS) with a 16.0426% null rate reflecting the aircraft registry join's coverage floor noted in the operator context.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model designation (121 distinct values, e.g. 172E) with a 16.0426% null rate matching aircraft_manufacturer's registry-join gaps.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was manufactured, 1956-2013, with a 17.6531% null rate from incomplete registry matches; a numeric label, not a measure.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Aircraft seat capacity, 2-450, with a 16.0426% null rate from incomplete registry matches; a measure of capacity that can be summed or averaged across flights.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Aircraft engine type (6 distinct values, e.g. Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet) with a 16.0426% null rate from incomplete registry matches.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name (3 distinct values: JFK, LaGuardia, Newark Liberty) with no nulls, complete per the operator context.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin airport's municipality (New York or Newark, 2 distinct values) with no nulls.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21; 3 distinct values) with no nulls; a label of the origin airport, not a per-flight measure.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Origin airport's longest runway length in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511) with no nulls; a label of the origin airport.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name (99 distinct values) with a 2.089% null rate matching the destination-airport join gaps noted in the operator context.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination airport's municipality (95 distinct values, e.g. Aguadilla, Akron) with a 2.089% null rate matching dest_airport_name's join gaps.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: ISO region code of the destination airport (45 distinct values, e.g. US-AL, PR-U-A) with a 2.089% null rate matching the destination-airport join gaps.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet, 3-6606, with a 2.089% null rate matching the destination-airport join gaps; a label of the destination airport.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Destination airport's longest runway length in feet, 5076-16000, with a 2.089% null rate matching the destination-airport join gaps.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Pipeline ingestion timestamp clustered at 2026-09-02T23:25:51 through 23:26:06 across 16 distinct values with no nulls; a technical capture time, not the business event time.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled commercial flight departing from a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) between January and June 2013, carrying its scheduled and, when available, actual departure and arrival times, delay and airborne-duration measures, aircraft registry attributes, and origin/destination airport characteristics as joined in the silver layer.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_flights enters the gold unified event star as the flights transaction-grain fact category, naming the event time column, the derived degenerate identity, and every field's role so the deterministic modeling engine can emit the gold fact and its dimensions.
usage: The mapping is rendered into an ODCS mapping contract, validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint, and reviewed by a human before the modeling engine emits any gold model from it; no transformation beyond the declared flight_identity tuple runs ahead of that gate.
limitations: The mapping does not resolve the 2.9%-3.3% null rates on actual departure/arrival times and delay/airtime measures, which the source's own contract attributes to flights that never departed; it does not resolve the 16.0%-17.7% null rates on aircraft registry fields or the 2.089% null rate on destination-airport attributes, both reflecting join coverage below completeness per the operator context. Consumers decide how to treat cancelled flights (is_cancelled) or rows with incomplete joins; this mapping proposes no filtering, derivation, or quality rule beyond the single transaction identity.
